requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic input schema that includes a required field for measure_type with allowed values: binary, categorical, continuous.
The system must define a raw_value field in the schema that accepts numeric, string, or boolean types depending on measure_type.
The system must include a normalization_method field specifying the transformation approach (e.g., min_max, z_score, mapping_table).
The system must define an output schema that includes a normalized_score field constrained to a float between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must enforce validation rules such that binary measure_type only accepts true/false or 0/1 raw_value inputs.
The system must enforce validation rules such that continuous measure_type requires numeric raw_value inputs.
The system must support categorical measure_type with a mapping configuration structure defining category-to-score mappings.
The system must include optional metadata fields in the schema to allow extension for future measure types without breaking existing contracts.
The system must validate that normalization_method is compatible with the provided measure_type.
The system must raise a validation error if required fields (measure_type, raw_value, normalization_method) are missing.
The system must raise a validation error if raw_value type does not match the expected type for the specified measure_type.
The system must ensure that the schema can be serialized and deserialized to JSON without loss of required fields or constraints.
The system must include explicit field descriptions in the schema to support downstream API contract clarity.
The system must support inclusion of normalization parameters (e.g., min, max, mean, std) as optional structured inputs when required by normalization_method.
